summary: BIDZONE Phase 6.4 frontend E2E — full happy+sad-path auction & bidding flow verified end-to-end via Playwright driving the preview URL against real Supabase. All 9 requested scenarios pass: signed-out guards (create + bid CTA), authenticated auction creation via /create UI (LIVE with no owner-draft-bar), owner-note visibility, Seller B min-increment enforcement (client 0.09 -> 'Bid below minimum' toast; 0.10 accepted), Seller C server-side increment enforcement (0.12 rejected; 0.15 accepted), current-bid & min-next-bid live updates (0.10/0.15 -> 0.15/0.20), bid history reflects latest bid, OutbidWatcher toast surfaces when returning as B, DB has OUTBID notification row for B, countdown decrements (14:57 -> 14:55 in 2.5s), cron closes short auction and ENDED UI renders (disabled 'Auction Ended' CTA, no bid-form). Cleanup PATCH DRAFT + DELETE succeeded (204) for all 3 test-created auctions.
critical_code_review_comments: CreateAuction.jsx signed-out notice actionLabel says 'Sign in with Google' but the auth modal supports email flow too — cosmetic wording, low priority.

OutbidWatcher toast fires on every reload where prevWinner ref transitions match; works correctly on the initial refetch because ref is initialized to null on mount, then set to top, and if subsequent refetch shows different top the toast fires — verified working; consider persisting last-seen top per (user,auction) if false-positives appear across route changes (none observed in this run).

Auth injection pattern: localStorage.setItem('sb-ialusnghydghsykekgeb-auth-token', JSON.stringify({access_token,token_type:'bearer',expires_in,expires_at:now+expires_in,refresh_token,user})) then reload. StatusHeader testid is 'auction-status-header' (not 'status-header'). BidHistory testid is 'bid-history'. Cleanup rule: RLS requires status='DRAFT' before DELETE on auctions. Cron closes expired auctions within ~30-60s reliably (observed ~5-30s in this run).
